_comment: Merit badges that references/Scouts-BSA-Requirements-2025.pdf cannot answer for,
because they were introduced, renamed, revised, or discontinued after that
book went to print. req.rb consults this list on every `show` and exits 3
with a banner when it hits one.
A badge does NOT need an entry here for req.rb to be loud about it: any name
the 2025 book does not contain already triggers the banner.
Nor does a badge merely REVISED for 2026. Those come from
references/Major-Requirement-Changes-as-of-1_1_2026.pdf, which changes.rb
parses -- all 65 of them, with the updated text. Do not hand-enter one here:
an entry here says 'this skill cannot supply these requirements' and exits 3,
which is wrong for a badge whose 2026 text is sitting in that document.
What is left for this file is what no local document can reveal: a badge
introduced, renamed, or discontinued after the 2025 printing, or one revised
by something published after the change list's 11/14/2025 date.
Fields, all optional except name and status:
name         the badge's current official name
status       new | revised | renamed | discontinued
effective    the year the change takes effect, e.g. "2026"
renamed_from the previous name, so the old name triggers the banner too
note         one line the Advancement Chair needs to act on
source       where the requirements actually live
Deliberately empty. Requirements change yearly and this repository's rule is
that advancement logic traces back to a document, never to recollection --
so entries go in only when someone has checked scouting.org/meritbadges.

badges.name: Artificial Intelligence
badges.note: New merit badge introduced after the 2025 printing; requirements are not in this book.
